blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Police arrested two individuals and seized suspected shabu worth an estimated P3.7 million during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Tomas Cabili here Tuesday afternoon. The Iligan City Police Office (ICPO) said the male suspects, aged 34 and 33, were arrested by joint operatives of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-10 (PDEA-10) and the local police in Purok 6, Palm Court, Barangay Tomas Cabili at around 2 p.m. The suspects are residents of Barangay San Miguel and Barangay Tomas Cabili.
